text:
maria_p: FYI - BrightPath onboarding stuck. Console shows "Provision pending" and customer can't get an API key. They hit /v1/generate and see 401. Ticket BP-9034.

devon: Which onboarding flow? SSO / OIDC or manual console?

maria_p: OIDC (Azure). Customer completed consent, claim came back, but the provision job never finishes. UI shows "Awaiting service role binding" with spinner.

jamal: Can you get a trace id or provisioner job id? Any provisioner logs?

maria_p: Customer provided trace=6f1a2b3c (2026-03-12T15:22Z). Their side got 202 on POST /internal/provision then long-poll never resolved.

onboard-bot: deploy-provisioner v3.4.1 - job provisioning/brightpath-ORG-901 queued in us-west-2

devon: Pasting internal repro steps to pull logs quickly:
```
# repro (internal)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/provision \
  -d '{"org":"brightpath","provider":"azure","claim":"<claim-blob>"}'
# poll status
curl https://api.redwood.internal/provision/status/<job-id>
```

maria_p: Redacted provisioner logs from us-west-2:
```
[2026-03-12T15:22:33Z] provisioner: start job brightpath-ORG-901
[2026-03-12T15:22:34Z] iam: create-service-account sa-brightpath-provisioner -> OK
[2026-03-12T15:22:35Z] iam: bind-role serviceAccount:sa-brightpath-provisioner -> ERROR: permissionDenied: caller does not have permission roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
[2026-03-12T15:22:35Z] provisioner: reconcile -> retry
```

jamal: That looks like a platform-side IAM permission error when binding roles. Could be node identity/workload identity problem on provisioner nodes.

devon: We saw this before when the nodepool identity connector was disabled after a maintenance; the provisioner pod lost ability to call IAM. Workaround was creating a manual API key while infra fixes cluster identity.

maria_p: Customer is in prod and blocked. They asked for an emergency key. Can infra create a temporary key scoped minimally?

eng-infra-oncall: Taking. I'll inspect the provisioner SA and the workload identity connector in us-west-2.

eng-infra-oncall: Found it - the workload identity pool connector for that nodepool was disabled during a maintenance window, so the provisioner lost permission to call IAM APIs. Re-enabling should restore binding. I can also create a manual API key and attach it to the org as a stopgap.

devon: If you create manual key, scope it to the production project bp-prod and limit scopes to `api:generate,api:embeddings`. Set expiration 30d and document rotation process.

eng-infra-oncall: Created key k_live_brightpath_01, attached to org brightpath (project bp-prod), inserted into console behind ticket BP-9034. Re-enabled connector and restarted provisioner pods. Monitoring job queue.

maria_p: Sent key to customer via secure channel and asked them to retry.

brightpath-customer: Confirmed - calls now return 200, no 401s. Thanks!

eng-infra-oncall: Provisioner resumed, backlog processed, job brightpath-ORG-901 completed at 2026-03-12T15:28Z. Recommend follow-ups: audit nodepool identity rotation procedure, add alert if workload identity connector toggles, and add a runbook for safe manual key issuance.

devon: I'll open INFRA-1129 to track permanent fix + runbook.

maria_p: Closing support ticket as resolved and escalating to infra (INFRA-1129). Will add KB entry to docs/support for "Provision pending" caused by node identity failures. :thumbsup:

jamal: Thanks all. Good to have documented manual fallback and alerting.

maria_p: Marking resolved.
